name: Bingles' Hammer
summary: At his crash site in Loch Modan, Bingles Blastenheimer needs Bingles' Hammer back from the troggs. With his gear restored, he can repair his flying machine and help free Gnomeregan.

sections.title: A Stranded Aviator's Toolkit
sections.body: Troggs raided Bingles Blastenheimer's crash site on the freshwater islands. They took his hammer and high-potency explosives. The hammer is needed to repair the dented airframe and adjust the gyrocopter's mechanical parts. Without his equipment, Bingles cannot fly support runs for the gnome forces fighting to reclaim Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Where can Bingles' Hammer be found?
faq.answer: Bingles' Hammer lies inside one of Bingles's Toolbuckets scattered across the trogg-infested islands in the northern Loch.

faq.q: Who does this hammer belong to?
faq.answer: The hammer belongs to Bingles Blastenheimer, a gnome engineer and pilot. His flying machine crashed along the shores of Loch Modan.

faq.q: Why is this tool so important to Bingles?
faq.answer: Bingles needs his full set of tools to rebuild his downed gyrocopter. He plans to fly it against the troggs and leper gnomes occupying Gnomeregan.
Troggs living on the lake islands raided the crash site. They took Bingles' toolbuckets and custom blastencapper explosives.

angles.text: As a gnome, each tool you recover brings the airborne assault to free your ancestral home closer.
As an engineer, you know a fine gnome-crafted hammer is hard to replace. Bingles needs one to rebuild his experimental gyrocopter in the wilderness.
